caption: A process moves from the ready queue to the CPU, back to ready when preempted, to a device queue on an I/O request, back to ready when the I/O finishes, and to terminated on exit.

spec.title: Queueing diagram
spec.aria: A flowchart where a PCB moves from the ready queue to the CPU, back to ready when preempted, to a device queue on an I/O request, back to ready when the I/O completes, and to the terminated state on exit.
